baseline_variant_id.description: Variant used as the comparison baseline.

comparison_id.description: Stable comparison ID. Reuse for an exact request retry.

expected_skill_version.description: Source version shown in the editor. Refuse a new trial if the instructions changed since setup.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this Signal scout config.

note.description: Steering instructions shared by every run in this trial, matching the trial UI's "Instructions for every run" field. Up to 1000 characters. Does not edit the saved scout's instructions.

variants.description: Up to 20 variants, each with up to 20 scout runs.

id.description: Stable variant identity within this comparison.

label.description: Variant name shown in the report.

launch_ids.description: Stable run IDs for this variant's repeats.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort supported by this model.

skill_body.description: Replacement scout instructions. Omit to use the saved source instructions.
